versos.e: .Chief preists, who feared to further persecute the disciples Ac 4:21; 5:26
.James and the Christian elders, who required Paul to observe certain rites Ac 21:18-26
.By Felix and Festus, concerning Paul Ac 24:27; 25:9
.The parents of the man who was born blind Joh 9:21,22
.Rulers, who believed in Jesus, but feared the Pharisees Joh 12:42,43
.Chief priests, who feared to answer the questions of Jesus Mt 21:26; Mr 11:18,32; 12:12
.By Herod (Antipas), in the case of John the Baptist Mr 6:26
